name: ZX_ACCOUNTS
description: This table contains default tax accounts for jurisdictions and rates which capture the financial implications of the tax. Each record represents default tax accounts defined by the internal organization for a jurisdiction or a rate.

columns.name: TAX_ACCOUNT_ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity for which the tax accounts are defined. Possible values include JURISDICTIONS and RATES.
